scripts.start: sh -lc 'if [ -n "$RENDER_SERVICE_ID" ] || [ -n "$RENDER_EXTERNAL_HOSTNAME" ] || [ "$RENDER" = "true" ]; then if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ] || echo "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -q "^file:"; then export SQLITE_DB_PATH="${SQLITE_DB_PATH:-/tmp/unitedlinkgroup.db}"; export DATABASE_URL="file:${SQLITE_DB_PATH}"; fi; fi; npm --workspace @unitedlinkgroup/database run db:push:deploy && npm --workspace api run start:prod'
